usage: cox stats gates [-h] [--db DB] [--since SINCE] [--store] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --db DB
  --since SINCE        keep only rows dated on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --store              read task and call rows from the run store instead of stats.db
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR  the run store's directory, with --store
  --json
